DisplayAccordion: Panels that open and close, built on native details elements. With a single item open at a time the browser does the exclusivity (details name), and hidden until-found lets the browser search inside closed panels. The open item can live in the URL.
DisplayChip: A small label that can be chosen and removed.
DisplayChipGroup: A group of chips that share a selection, one or several.
DisplayList: A list of items that can be chosen, one or several.
DisplayTimeline: Events in order, with a time element for each.
DisplayRating: A score shown as stars, with a text alternative. To let the visitor choose the score use FormRating.
DisplayEmptyState: What to show when there is nothing to show yet: icon, title, text and actions.
DisplayStat: A figure with its label and how it changed, read by a screen reader as words and not only as an arrow.
FeedbackAlert: A message with a status, that can be dismissed.
FeedbackToastContainer: Where the toasts of useToast show. It is a manual popover in the top layer, so the toasts stay above the dialogs.
FeedbackProgress: A progress bar on the native progress element, or a ring.
FeedbackSkeleton: A placeholder that shows where content will come.
FeedbackBanner: A message at the top of the page, that can be dismissed and remembered.
FeedbackCookieBanner: A consent banner with categories. The answer is remembered and the banner comes back when a category is added.
NavigationTabs: Tabs with arrow keys, automatic or manual activation, hidden until-found panels and an optional state in the URL.
NavigationPagination: Pagination made of real links (it works without JavaScript and can be crawled), or buttons. The page can live in the URL.
NavigationBreadcrumb: The path to the current page, with aria-current.
NavigationStepper: The steps of a process, linear or not, with the current step optionally in the URL.
NavigationTreeView: A tree with the tree roles, a roving tabindex, arrow keys, typeahead and expand all.
NavigationCommandPalette: A command palette on the native dialog element, opened with Ctrl or Cmd K, with grouped and filtered commands.
NavigationSkipLink: A link to jump to the main content, shown only with the keyboard focus.
NavigationBackToTop: A button that appears after some scrolling and goes back to the top, without animation if the visitor asked for less motion.
OverlayModal: A dialog on the native dialog element (showModal, closedby, requestClose, returnValue), with a script fallback for browsers that lack it. The open state can live in the URL.
OverlayDialog: A confirm or alert dialog that answers with a form method dialog.
OverlayDrawer: A panel that comes from any edge of the screen, or a bottom sheet.
OverlayPopover: A floating panel on the Popover API, placed next to its trigger with flip and shift.
OverlayDropdown: A menu on the Popover API, with the keyboard of the menu pattern and typeahead.
OverlayTooltip: A short text that shows on hover and focus.
OverlayContextMenu: A menu that opens at the pointer on a right click, or with the menu key and Shift F10, kept inside the window.
FormCombobox: A text field with a list of options (role combobox and listbox), filtered while typing without caring for case or accents. Options can come from a server and values can be created.
FormMultiSelect: A combobox that keeps several values as removable chips.
FormCalendar: A month grid with a roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home, End and page keys, bounds, disabled days and range selection.
FormDatePicker: A date field with a calendar panel, formatted with Intl, one date or a range.
FormRangeSlider: Two thumbs on two native range inputs that cannot cross.
FormRating: Stars the visitor can choose, with half steps and the keyboard (slider role).
FormOtp: A one-time code with one box per digit, paste support and automatic advance.
FormTimePicker: Hours and minutes in 12 or 24 hour display, the value is always HH:MM.
FormTagsInput: Free text turned into removable chips, with separators and paste.
FormColorPicker: The native colour input with a hex field (and opacity) and a palette.
FormFileDropzone: Drag and drop plus a button, with accept, size and count limits, previews and errors.
DataTable: A table with sort, a global search, column filters (text, list, range), pagination and selection. In server mode it only shows the rows it gets and asks for the next ones with the query event. Its state can live in the URL.
DataVirtualScroll: A long list that draws only what is visible.
DataInfiniteScroll: Asks for more when the end of the list comes near, with an IntersectionObserver.
DataSortableList: A list that can be reordered with the pointer and with the keyboard, with announcements for screen readers.
ContentKbd: A key or a combination of keys.
ContentCodeBlock: A block of code with line numbers, highlighted lines, wrapping, a maximum height, a copy button and a pluggable highlighter.
ContentCodeGroup: Code blocks in tabs. The choice is shared between the groups with the same name and remembered.
ContentTerminal: A terminal session: commands as kbd, output as samp, and a copy that takes only the commands.
ContentJsonViewer: A JSON tree on nested details elements, with search, path and copy.
ContentDiff: A diff in unified or split view, with ins and del elements.
ContentCallout: A highlighted note, tip or warning.
ContentMarkdown: Renders Markdown with a small renderer that escapes the text and only produces safe tags, or with a renderer of your own.
LayoutAppBar: The top bar of an application, with leading, title and trailing areas.
LayoutBottomNavigation: A tab bar for small screens.
LayoutSpacer: Takes the free room of a flex container.
LayoutSticky: Keeps an element at an edge while the page scrolls.
LayoutSplitter: Two resizable panes with a separator, the keyboard and the pointer.
MediaCarousel: Slides with scroll snap, indicators and the keyboard. Autoplay pauses on hover and focus and is off when the visitor asked for less motion.
MediaLazyImage: An image that loads late and asynchronously, with a placeholder, a fallback and an error state.
MediaLightbox: Thumbnails that open a large view in a native dialog, with the keyboard and captions.
MediaPlayer: A video or audio player with the controls of the browser or accessible controls of its own.
UtilityThemeSwitcher: Light, dark or system theme, written as data-theme on the page and remembered.
UtilityShareButton: Shares with the system sheet (Web Share API) or copies the address.
UtilityCountdown: A countdown in a time element, not announced every second.
